instructions: Season the chicken all over with 1½ teaspoons of the salt and 1 teaspoon of the pepper.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken 2 pieces at a time and cook 4-5 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through (165°F). Set aside covered to keep warm and repeat with the remaining chicken.
Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine according to the package directions. Drain and return to the pot.

While the pasta cooks, heat the remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the shallot and garlic with a pinch of salt and cook 3-4 minutes, until the shallot is translucent.

Whisk in the flour and cook 3-4 minutes, until golden brown. Add the coconut milk and chicken stock, bring to a low boil for about 1 minute, then reduce to low-medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes, until thickened. Stir in the lemon juice and season with the remaining 2 teaspoons salt and 1½ teaspoons pepper.
Pour the sauce over the fettuccine and toss well to coat. Slice the chicken.
Divide the pasta between bowls, top with the sliced chicken, and garnish with parsley.
notes: Dairy-free alfredo made with coconut milk instead of cream — fully dairy-free as written.
source: Tasty (BuzzFeed) — YouTube: The Best Dairy-Free Chicken Alfredo
title: Dairy-Free Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo
